headline: IRCON wins ₹862 cr EPC contract from East Central Railway. Stock up ~6% intraday.
so_what: Railway capex pipeline intact. Order book ~₹23,366 cr.

headline: RailTel bags ₹63.8 cr order from Northern Coalfields
so_what: Steady small-ticket order flow for railway PSUs.

headline: BEL secures ₹730 cr of defence orders (radar, avionics, EW, cyber)
so_what: Defence electronics demand stays strong despite the market slump.

headline: Jio Financial board meets Oct 15 for Q2 FY27 results
so_what: Q1 profit rose ~156% YoY. Expect a volatile session.

headline: RBI raises repo rate 25 bp to 5.50% (unanimous)
so_what: Rates going up weighs on equities but raises liquid fund yields.

headline: Nifty logs an 8th straight weekly loss, its longest streak in ~25 years. FII selling, $100 crude, weak rupee.
so_what: Sentiment is washed out. Historically better for patient buyers than for sellers.

headline: Nifty holds 22,200 support. 22,800 is the hurdle to clear.
so_what: A close above 22,800 would be the first sign of a turn.

headline: FPIs sold ~₹34,000 cr in September. 2026 outflows are ~₹2.45 lakh cr, above all of 2025.
so_what: Domestic SIP flows are absorbing the selling. A reversal in FII flows would be a big tailwind.

headline: Gold range-bound near $4,130–4,160/oz. Festive demand supports it.
so_what: Your gold is above target. Hold it, don't add.
